You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Dalillai 5 da kimiyya ta tabbatar na cewa cin naman Alade bashi da kyau bayan Musulunci da ya haramta

output.original_text: Dalillai 5 da kimiyya ta tabbatar na cewa cin naman Alade bashi da kyau bayan Musulunci da ya haramta

output.sadness: Abin takaici, kimiyya ta nuna dalilai guda biyar da suka tabbatar da cewa cin naman Alade ba ya dace bayan Musulunci ya haramta shi.
output.fear: Duk da haka, akwai dalilai guda biyar daga kimiyya da suka tabbatar da cewa ciwon naman Alade na iya zama mai hadari bayan Musulunci ya haramta.
output.anger: Ya kamata mu daina cin naman Alade! Kimiyya ta tabbatar da dalilai guda biyar da ke nuna yana da matukar hadari bayan Musulunci ya haramta.
output.surprise: Na yi mamaki idan na ga kimiyya ta tabbatar da dalilai guda biyar game da cin naman Alade wanda Musulunci ya haramta!
output.disgust: Abin kunya ne yadda kimiyya ta tabbatar da dalilai guda biyar da suka nuna cewa cin naman Alade ba shi da kyau bayan Musulunci ya haramta!
